engine: Kokoro-82M via kokoro-onnx 0.6.1; blends are weighted averages of style vectors; all clips rendered by tools/voice/render.py

dana.name: Dana Whitfield
dana.personality: Calm and direct ex-SRE; says the hard thing once, kindly.

primary.why: Lowest female pitch in the cast (~155 Hz) and a touch slower: reads as mature and unhurried, not young or bubbly.

alternates.why: Warmest base voice, slowed; leans kind over direct. Close to Amara in pitch.

kenji.name: Kenji Mori
kenji.personality: Terse and benchmark-driven; decides fast, admits when wrong.

primary.why: Deepest male in the cast (~100 Hz), slightly brisk: curt, senior, no wasted words. Onyx alone is too deep and flat, so Michael adds some life.

alternates.why: Equally deep, British; reads dry and clipped.
A little lighter (~115 Hz) with Fenrir's crisp consonants.

ines.name: Ines Duarte
ines.personality: High-bar reviewer who teaches by asking.

primary.why: Crisp, mid-high (~180 Hz), a little quick: sharp and precise, young but not girlish. Sits between Dana (low) and Amara (high).

alternates.why: Kore with a hint of British Emma: composed, slightly formal.
Best British female; articulate, teacherly. Accent may feel off for a US team.

theo.name: Theo Lindqvist
theo.personality: Fast, friendly, ships quickly and sometimes sloppily.

primary.why: Mid-pitch (~125-130 Hz) and 10% faster: easygoing, quick, casual. Sits between Kenji (deep) and Leo (high).

alternates.why: Lively, energetic, grade C+; very fast, may be too hyper.
Puck's energy steadied by Liam; lower than the primary.

primary.why: Highest and brightest voice in the cast (~205 Hz), warm and persuasive; the energy of someone relaying a customer's pain.

leo.name: Leo Park
leo.personality: Eager, hesitant to ask for help.

primary.why: Highest male in the cast (~160 Hz), slightly slower: boyish and a bit tentative. Grade D base voice, so listen for roughness.

alternates.why: Echo and Eric: lower (~130 Hz) and calmer, less boyish.
Eric with a soft British edge; gentle, polite.
